div.head: Wif 6
div.ab: Gif hy ðonne ælces ðinges sammæle beon, ðonne fon magas to 7 wedian heora magan to wife 7 to rihtlife ðam ðe hire gyrnde; 7 fo to ðam borge se ðe ðæs weddes waldend sy.
Si tunc in omni re concordent, adeat cognatio et despondeat eam (uiro) to ƿiue ⁊ to rihtliue (id est in uxorem et rectam uitam); et excipiat inde plegium qui ius habet in uadio.
Gif hy þonne ælces þinges sammæle beon, ðonne fon magas to 7 weddian heora magan to wife 7 to rihtlife ðam ðe hire girnde; 7 fo to þæm borge se ðe ðæs weddes waldend sy.

If they then reach agreement about everything, then the kinsmen are to set about betrothing their kinswoman as wife and in lawful matrimony to him who has asked for her, and he who is leader of the betrothal is to receive the security.

Wenn nun die [beiden Parteien] über jedes Ding einverstanden sind, mögen [die Braut-]Sippen [das Verlöbniss] annehmen, indem sie ihre Verwandte zum Eheweibe und gesetzmässigen [Zusammen]leben demjenigen verloben, der ihrer begehrt hat; und jene Bürgschaft empfange, wer Leiter des Verlobungsvertrages ist.

If the [two parties] then agree on everything, let the [bride's] kindred accept [the betrothal] by betrothing their kinswoman as wife and to lawful [married] life to him who has sought her; and let whoever is the controller of the betrothal agreement receive the surety.
div.note: B's ‘wedian’ stands so.; U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘If they then reach agreement about everything, then the kinsmen are to set about betrothing their kinswoman as wife and in lawful matrimony to him who has asked for her, and he who is the leader of the betrothal is to receive the security.’).
